Order 
22.03.2023 Order No.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and the learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.02 of 2020 pending on the file of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Phulbani, arising out of K. Nuagaon P.S. Case No.03 of 2020 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 363/366/323/506/376(2)(n)/376(3)
IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Phulbani by order dated 02.08.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner does not want to press I.A No.348 of 2023 for modification of the order dated 20.01.2023.
5. Accordingly, I.A. stands disposed of as not pressed.
6. Taking into account the nature of accusation and the recitals in I.A. No.467 of 2023 for interim bail, this Court is not inclined to entertain the same.

Accordingly, I.A No.467 of 2023 stands disposed of.

8. Since it is revealed from the status report of the learned Court in seisin that 13 witnesses out of 16 witnesses have already been examined including the victim and the informant and considering that the Petitioner is in custody since 15.10.2020 and the progress in trial, this Court is not inclined to entertain this application at this stage.
9. The BLAPL stands thus disposed of.

10. As the Petitioner is stated to be in custody from 15.10.2020, learned Court in seisin is called upon to conclude the trial within a period of two months from the date of receipt/production of the copy of this order.

11. It shall be open to the Petitioner to renew his prayer for bail in the event the trial is not concluded within the time stipulated and the same shall be considered on its own merit without being influenced by the earlier rejection or the order passed by this Court.
12. Registry is requested to communicate this order to the learned Court in seisin.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
